stops.note: an ethno-cultural self-designation meaning roughly 'noble, of good family'
the related Iranian self-designation, source of the name 'Iran'
stops.meaning: the Iranian peoples' name for themselves

stops.note: philologist Friedrich Schlegel linked the word to Indo-European studies
adopted from German scholarship as a linguistic term, later distorted into a racial category
stops.meaning: historically, a term for Indo-Iranian peoples or languages

current_meaning: Historically a self-designation of the ancient Indo-Iranian peoples; in the 19th-20th centuries, misappropriated as a pseudo-scientific racial category.
